slash.name: poly-lsp
slash.description: code navigation (poly-lsp): lets the model find definitions and uses, and rename
slash.help:
Code navigation (poly-lsp) lets the model find where a name is defined and where it is used, read a function by its name, and rename it across files. It uses each language's own tools (gopls, tsserver, pylsp) where they are installed.
/poly-lsp on — turn it on for this session
/poly-lsp auto — turn it on in every session of this project
/poly-lsp off, /poly-lsp manual — the same two, to turn it off
/poly-lsp exclude <dir> — leave a directory out of the index, for this project (dun does this itself when the index stops at its file limit, and says so)
/poly-lsp include <dir> — put it back
/poly-lsp alone — whether it is on, its index, and what it leaves out
